Here's a way to see it. Think of the product as the area of a rectangle, with width e to the x and height sine x. At x equals one, it's about two point seven two wide, and point eight four high. So the area changes in two ways, one factor changing while the other stays. Divide by the nudge, and that's the product rule from Year 11: u prime v, plus u v prime.
